evidence_spans.snippet: I2C address A: 0x44 (default) ADDR (pin 2) connected to logic low
I2C address B: 0x45 ADDR (pin 2) connected to logic high
e.g. 0x2130: 1 high repeatability mps - measurement per second
Reset command using the general call address: 0x0006
Command to read out the status register: 0xF32D
Command to clear the status register: 0x3041
Measurement duration high repeatability: max 15 ms
CRC-8, polynomial 0x31, initialization 0xFF, reflect input false, reflect output false, final XOR 0x00
